lead.zh: Marc Chalmé 是一位法国具象画家，他精心建构的室内、安静街道与风景围绕受控的光线与
lead.en: Marc Chalmé is a French figurative painter whose constructed interiors, quiet streets, and landscapes are organized around controlled light and

body.zh: 主要媒介为布面油画，另有素描和板上油画。有据可查的职业履历以商业画廊展览为主，曾在巴黎、纽约、波士顿、伦敦、苏黎世和圣莫里茨举办个展。本次查阅未找到可核实的公共美术馆收藏；公开拍卖资料只有一条不公开价格的 2021 年记录，无法进行价格统计或趋势分析。
body.en: Recent documented works are mainly oil on canvas, with drawings and oil on board also present. His career record is primarily commercial-gallery based, with solo presentations in Paris, New York, Boston, London, Zurich, and St. Moritz. No public-museum collection record was verified, and accessible public-auction coverage consists of one price-restricted 2021 record, preventing price statistics or trend analysis.

interactionLead.zh: 生平资料难以解释创作
interactionLead.en: Biography explains little of the practice

interactionBody.zh: 现有简历只记录学习地点、长期兼任教学以及画廊年表，没有艺术家自述或独立资料说明这些经历如何影响创作。本报告因此不推断生平与画面之间的因果关系。
interactionBody.en: Available biographies record places of study, long-term teaching, and a gallery chronology; no artist statement or independent source explains how these shaped the work, so no causal link is inferred.

summary.zh: 他反复使用清晰、精心建构的建筑、物件与风景，同时减少叙事行动；黄昏、夜晚、人工照明、窗户、反射、空房间与近乎无人的街道反复出现。
summary.en: He repeatedly uses legible, carefully constructed architecture, objects, and landscapes while minimizing narrative action; dusk, night, artificial illumination, windows, reflections, empty rooms, and partly deserted streets recur.

detail.zh: 近期作品以布面油画为主，尺寸从小幅至 160 × 200 厘米；2023 年 Catto 展览中也有素描和板上油画。
detail.en: Recent works are mainly oil on canvas, from small formats to 160 × 200 cm; the 2023 Catto exhibition also included drawings and oil on board.

detail.zh: 街道与建筑、风景边界、室内、静物、镜子、窗帘、人物、树木，以及夜晚或昼夜转换时的天空。
detail.en: Streets and architecture, landscape edges, interiors, still lifes, mirrors, curtains, figures, trees, and night or twilight skies.

detail.zh: 黄昏、夜晚、人工照明、阴影与反射光持续组织画面。
detail.en: Dusk, night, artificial light, shadow, and reflected light consistently organize the image.

detail.zh: 较早的画廊文字提到女性、儿童和家庭片段；2023 年 Catto 展览强调人物大多已退场。证据不足以据此划分创作阶段。
detail.en: Earlier gallery texts mention women, children, and domestic scenes; the 2023 Catto show stresses that figures have largely withdrawn. Evidence is insufficient to define phases from this.

gap.zh: 已查阅来源中没有找到艺术家本人撰写或可归属的创作陈述。
gap.en: No artist-authored or attributable statement was located in the reviewed sources.

interpretation.zh: 画廊将熟悉的家庭和街道场景解读为带有梦境感、仿佛悬置于时间之外、有时略显诡秘的画面。
interpretation.en: The gallery reads familiar domestic and street scenes as dreamlike, temporally suspended, and at times eerie.

source.label: M Fine Arts Galerie — Marc Chalmé

interpretation.zh: 画廊以“介于两者之间的状态”解读 2023 年作品：人物退场，自然似将进入室内；并提出与 de Chirico、Magritte 的联系。这是画廊阐释，不是学术共识。
interpretation.en: The gallery frames the 2023 works as an in-between state in which figures withdraw and nature seems to enter interiors, and suggests links to de Chirico and Magritte. This is gallery interpretation, not scholarly consensus.

interpretation.zh: 2022 年评论认为其创作完全建立在具象绘画之上，核心是细致建构的室内外空间、空旷街道以及光影互动。
interpretation.en: A 2022 review describes a fully figurative practice centered on carefully constructed interiors and exteriors, empty streets, and the interplay of shadow and light.

source.label: Galeries & Musées — Les cadres nocturnes du peintre Marc Chalmé

synthesis.zh: 系统综合：光线是画面中的主要事件，标记室内与室外、白昼与黑夜、在场与缺席之间的边界。此判断基于作品记录、一篇独立评论和两家画廊的解读，不代表艺术家本人表达的意图。
synthesis.en: System synthesis: light functions as the primary event, marking thresholds between inside and outside, day and night, presence and absence. Built from work records, one independent review, and two gallery readings; not stated artist intent.

note.zh: 随 2022 年独立评论刊出，作为夜间建构空间的例子。
note.en: Reproduced with the 2022 independent review as an example of nocturnal constructed space.

note.zh: 小尺幅街道／建筑场景，连接车站母题与夜间环境。
note.en: A small street/architectural scene linking the station motif to a nocturnal setting.

note.zh: 连接室内、反射与经过安排的家庭空间；Catto 标注已售，未披露价格。
note.en: Connects interior, reflection, and staged domestic space; marked sold by Catto without a disclosed price.

note.zh: 代表 Catto 展览文字中的暮色风景；截止日画廊报价 8,950 英镑，不是拍卖成交。
note.en: Represents the twilight landscapes in Catto's text; gallery asking price GBP 8,950 at cutoff, not an auction result.

note.zh: 大尺幅展品，连接近期标题中反复出现的“梦”；标注已售，价格未披露。
note.en: Large-format work linked to the recurring dream vocabulary in recent titles; marked sold, price not disclosed.

note.zh: 大尺幅人物／室内作品，说明 2023 年展览并非全是无人风景；标注已售。
note.en: Large figurative/interior work showing the 2023 show was not only unpopulated landscape; marked sold.

note.zh: 说明素描是与油画并行的媒介。
note.en: Documents drawing as a parallel medium to painting.

note.zh: 小尺幅板上作品与人工城市光线；截止日画廊报价 2,500 英镑。
note.en: Small board format and artificial urban light; gallery asking price GBP 2,500 at cutoff.

intro.zh: 现有来源提供了有日期的作品和展览，但没有足够的独立资料或艺术家自述来建立具有明确转变依据的创作阶段。
intro.en: Sources provide dated works and exhibitions but not enough independent evidence or artist statements to establish phases with documented transitions.

gapNote.zh: 未公开核实：若把较早的人物家庭场景与 2023 年更空旷的风景划为不同阶段，会过度依赖画廊文字和不完整的作品样本，因此不设早期／中期／晚期阶段。
gapNote.en: Not publicly verified: splitting earlier figurative domestic scenes from the emptier 2023 landscapes would over-rely on gallery copy and an incomplete image sample, so no early/middle/late phases are asserted.

comparisonBody.zh: Catto 公开页面显示 2023 年作品的画廊报价从《Blue Neon》2,500 英镑到《Nightfall》8,950 英镑不等，多件标注已售但未公布价格。这些是一级市场报价，未与拍卖记录合并计算。

aggregateReason.zh: 只有一个价格不可见的样本；数据商显示的 100% 成交率无法支持中位数、成交率或趋势分析。
aggregateReason.en: One price-hidden observation; the provider's displayed 100% sold rate cannot support a median, sell-through, or trend analysis.

summary.zh: 可核实的动能信号集中在商业画廊体系：三家当前代理、2023 年首次英国个展、一次艺博会展示、一篇独立评论，以及一级市场的已售标注。未核实到机构展览、奖项或公共收藏；拍卖证据只有一条不公开价格的记录。
summary.en: Verifiable momentum signals sit within the commercial-gallery system: three current representatives, a first UK solo show in 2023, one fair presentation, one independent review, and primary-market sold markers. No institutional exhibition, prize, or public collection was verified, and auction evidence is a single price-hidden record.
